coordinate_frames.task_space: upstream end-effector fields were dropped; no task-space action may be inferred
coordinate_frames.urdf_joint: explicit upstream URDF-radian fields were dropped by the merge

data_format: LeRobot v3.0 Parquet plus mixed H.264/AV1 MP4
embodiment: SO-101 single arm, six source actuators in Isaac simulation
known_limitations: No success, failure, quality or benchmark success-rate labels are published; demonstration status must not be converted into a success label.
meta/tasks.parquet stores task text in the nonstandard __index_level_0__ column rather than the LeRobot v3 task column; the adapter normalizes it explicitly.
The merge drops upstream URDF-radian, end-effector, gripper-helper, skill and subtask fields, preventing a proven task-space conversion and discarding useful supervision.
The exact native actuator calibration/units are not published; upstream evidence proves an affine relation to explicit URDF radians for one source, but that transform is absent from the merge.
Four declared upstream repository names currently resolve to Cache-SCA mirrors; declared and resolved IDs plus immutable revisions are pinned.
The SCRAPE-IsaacLab collection-code URL referenced by source cards returned HTTP 404 on 31 August 2026, so collection-code reproducibility cannot be independently verified.
Published meta/stats.json contains stale aggregate counts (420171 or 89862 for most fields instead of 358006); qualification recomputes statistics from the trajectory table.
Video codecs are mixed per packed file; at least one upstream card describes H.264 while the merged task also contains AV1 files.
Close-pot episode 447 includes nine unused video frames in each camera interval; only the first trajectory-length frames are aligned and eligible.
The source publishes only a train split and has no session/seed identifier beyond task and episode order.
native_action_semantics: Absolute source-calibrated SO-101 actuator commands. The merged release drops explicit URDF-radian fields and does not publish the calibration transform; values must remain source-native.
redistribution_terms: Preserve the Apache-2.0 license and notices, state material changes, and do not use contributor names or marks to imply endorsement.
simulator_version: Mixed upstream provenance; documented MA sources use Isaac Sim 5.1 and IsaacLab 2.3.2, while CAP cards omit exact versions.

unit_conventions.gripper: source_calibrated_motor_coordinate; observed range is not the physical 0..100 convention
